column2: WARNING: THESE ARE OUR TRANSLATIONS, NOT SE's. dat.pak ships all 95 area names in
Japanese (fet_area, the `name_jp` column of fe-fet-area.tsv) and ships no
English anywhere -- the dat.pak string harvest finds only 7 of the 95 and
pairs them with the wrong English, so there is nothing to recover. Each row
below romanises the proper noun and translates the geographic suffix.
What this replaces: five invented names hardcoded in docker-compose
covering fields 1..5, and nothing at all for the other 90.
The suffixes, so a correction stays consistent with the rest:
渓流 Ravine   渓谷 Valley    山麓 Foothills   山脈 Mountains
高地 Highlands 高原 Uplands  台地 Plateau     盆地 Basin
平原 Plains   草原 Grasslands 緑地 Greenwood  荒地 Wastes
雪原 Snowfield 湿原 Marsh    島 Isle          半島 Peninsula
海峡 Strait   河口 Estuary   水源 Springs     水域 Waters
上流域 Upper Reaches         隕石跡 Meteor Crater
遺跡 Ruins    古戦場跡 Battlefield            街道 Road
丘陵 Hills    大地 Land      の地 Land of
Areas 91..95 are the second halves of the five capitals and carry the same
name as 21/39/57/62/78, which is what dat.pak does too.
